exercise.directions: Read the two sources carefully, then answer the questions below using specific details from the texts.
exercise.goal: Compare two short descriptive texts about community altar building and family remembrance.

questions.answer: Source A highlights family photos and lit candles for remembrance, while Source B focuses on food offerings like fruit, water, and sugar skulls.
questions.prompt: Based on Source A and Source B, what is one main difference between how the two altars are decorated or prepared?

questions.answer: Families place these items to welcome and refresh visiting souls with things they enjoyed in life.
questions.prompt: Why do families place specific items like water and favorite foods on their ofrendas during Dia de los Muertos?

stimuli.label: Source A
stimuli.text: Source A: The Martinez family builds their home altar with glowing candles and framed black-and-white photographs of their grandparents. Bright orange marigolds line the base to guide visiting spirits with their warm scent.

stimuli.label: Source B
stimuli.text: Source B: In the town square, the community ofrenda features sweet sugar skulls, fresh sweet bread, and cups of fresh water. These offerings are carefully prepared to refresh and welcome traveling souls.
